926.summary: The class covers the prophecy of Joel, focusing on the judgment of nations and the establishment of the kingdom of God. It explores the symbolism and patterns in Joel, linking them to historical and future events.

927.summary: The class covers Joel's prophecy, focusing on the Day of the Lord as a time of judgment and deliverance. It discusses the imagery of divine judgment and the promise of the Holy Spirit's outpouring in the future kingdom period.
